metrics_finding.finding: The auth-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization during the failure window, with a change of 0.0002999999999999999 from its baseline value.

evidence_summary.summary: The auth-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization during the failure window, which is inconsistent with its baseline value.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize CPU resource allocation for the auth-service.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident appears to be a CPU utilization issue in the auth-service. Further investigation is required to determine the underlying cause and implement a fix.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण प्रमाणिक सेवा (auth-service) में सीपीयू उपयोग बढ़ जाना दिखाई देता है। अतिरिक्त विश्लेषण आवश्यक है ताकि अंतर्निहित कारण निर्धारित किया जा सके और एक समाधान लागू किया जा सके।
